commands.review_summary:
The PR adds reset-boundary one-shot usage refresh scheduling in UsageStore plus focused tests for primary, secondary, extra, retry, and in-flight refresh cases.

Reproducibility: yes. from source inspection: current main only refreshes on the configured timer, so a snapshot whose reset boundary occurs before the next poll can stay visible as already expired. I did not run live provider probes because repository policy warns against real-account and Keychain-prompting validation.

target.title: fix: refresh usage after quota reset boundaries
target.body:
## Summary
- refresh usage shortly after known quota reset boundaries when the boundary is earlier than the configured polling cadence
- suppress repeated prompt retries when provider failures preserve stale data after a boundary refresh attempt
- cover primary, secondary, and extra rate windows with focused scheduler tests

## Review Follow-up
- Boundary-triggered refreshes now record the attempted boundary refresh time when the one-shot fires.
- The scheduler excludes already-attempted boundary refreshes, so preserved stale snapshots fall back to normal polling instead of scheduling another prompt retry.
- Regression proof: `suppressesRepeatedPromptRefreshAfterAttemptedBoundary` models a preserved stale snapshot after an attempted boundary refresh and verifies no prompt retry is scheduled.
- No live provider or Keychain probe was run, per repository guidance to avoid live provider probes and keychain-prompting checks.

## Validation
- `git diff --check`
- `swift test --filter UsageStoreResetBoundaryRefreshTests`
- `make check`
- `swift test --no-parallel --filter '(^CodexBarTests\.CostUsageScannerBreakdownTests/)'`
- `/usr/bin/env CODEXBAR_TEST_SUITE_TIMEOUT=420 make test`

Note: default `make test` uses a 180 second per-suite timeout on this machine. The existing `CostUsageScannerBreakdownTests` suite passed but takes about 321-323 seconds locally, so the full suite was run with the repo-supported `CODEXBAR_TEST_SUITE_TIMEOUT=420` override.
